_comment: Merit live demo config (testnet only). Edit contract_id / dao_id here if the deploy landed on a fallback name. No keys in this file: keys live only in .testnet-accounts.json (chmod 600).

dispute.criteria: Repair the gate hinge so the gate swings freely and latches. Before and after photos required.
dispute.description: Poster disputes the work; the DAO council judges the evidence and pays in full.
dispute.poster_evidence_text: poster evidence: hinge still stiff in the photo, gate does not latch
dispute.title: Dispute demo: repair the gate hinge
dispute.worker_evidence_text: worker evidence: hinge repaired, gate swings freely and latches in the photo

lend.criteria: Weld the side gate shut, same standard as the front gate.
lend.description: Accepted by the lend delegate (the poster), proving access moved with the lend.
lend.title: Lend demo: weld the side gate

lend_check.criteria: Never accepted: this job exists only to record the post-expiry refusal.
lend_check.description: Created to prove the delegate is refused after the lend expires. Left Open on purpose: its 0.01 NEAR escrow stays locked (no cancel method).
lend_check.title: Lend demo: expired access check

main.criteria: Weld the gate: continuous beads, no porosity, ground flush. Photo of the finished weld required.
main.description: Weld the front gate shut: continuous beads, no porosity, ground flush.
main.title: Weld the demo gate

refusal.criteria: Hold a Merit stamped merit-basics 1 and welding 2.
refusal.description: Deliberately refused: a blank Merit with no stamps tries to open this gated job.
refusal.title: Demo refusal gate

timeout.criteria: Weld the back gate shut, same standard as the front gate.
timeout.description: Poster stays silent past the 60 second deadline; anyone releases the escrow.
timeout.title: Timeout demo: weld the back gate
